selected_evidence.requirement: Pre-change baseline: filesystem type, mount options, no existing datauser/quota
selected_evidence.summary: Shows root is XFS mounted 'noquota', datauser does not yet exist, /srv/data does not yet exist

selected_evidence.requirement: XFS uquota accounting enabled on the filesystem hosting /srv/data
selected_evidence.summary: grubby adds rootflags=uquota, fstab updated with usrquota, and post-activation-reboot mount output shows '/dev/vda4 on / type xfs (...,usrquota)'

selected_evidence.requirement: datauser account and /srv/data directory created and owned correctly
selected_evidence.summary: useradd datauser (nologin, home /srv/data) and /srv/data created with owner datauser:datauser mode 700

selected_evidence.requirement: 100MB quota limit configured for datauser, filesystem-enforced
selected_evidence.summary: xfs_quota limit set bsoft=100m bhard=100m for datauser; report confirms 100M/100M limits

selected_evidence.requirement: Quota enforcement demonstrated (writes beyond 100MB rejected by the filesystem)
selected_evidence.summary: 90MB write succeeds; subsequent write fails mid-stream with 'dd: error writing: Disk quota exceeded' at ~99MB usage, proving kernel-level XFS enforcement

selected_evidence.requirement: Mandatory restart protocol: healthy baseline (boot id + service/data health) before restart
selected_evidence.summary: Captured pre-restart boot_id 368441cc-d525-4a81-95cd-a216a963a2c9, and wrote/verified marker.txt (sha256 0822dc01...) in /srv/data as data health proof

selected_evidence.requirement: Mandatory restart protocol: restart acknowledgement and connectivity loss/recovery
selected_evidence.summary: Reboot command acknowledged and returned before disconnect; subsequent exec calls show connection reset/timeout confirming the node actually went down

selected_evidence.requirement: Mandatory restart protocol: proof of changed boot identity
selected_evidence.summary: Post-restart boot_id is 4b91a1cc-ef2b-4305-bc7a-a8e04a7d81a3, different from the pre-restart value 368441cc-..., proving an actual reboot occurred

selected_evidence.requirement: Mandatory restart protocol: post-restart recovery of required services/data and continued quota enforcement
selected_evidence.summary: After restart, / still mounted usrquota, datauser quota still 100M, marker.txt content/sha256 unchanged, and a new dd write again fails with 'Disk quota exceeded' at ~99MB, confirming enforcement persisted across reboot; test file cleaned up afterward
